Atlas

Variation 05 of the phase 36 phone, round two. Same data as ios-2, same components, a different direction: Today is a body, not a list. Tap an organ and its markers open under it. Move the pointer across the figure and the layers separate in real depth. Press Play and the Add flow runs. Tick a chip and the ring, the streak and the week strip answer. Switch a food rule and the projection redraws — and the heart on the figure changes colour to the state it will be in eight weeks.

00

Direction

VwuDuqaQ7mUAcQUAR5uX32Np

The read
Two things fall out of it. First a word: a · Q · U · A sits in order inside aQ7mUA — water, which is what a body mostly is and what every marker on file was measured in. Second the digits, 7 5 3 2, descending, and they are already the day: 7 markers off, 5 moves, 3 meals, 2 of them ticked. Five u's (three lower, two upper) for five layers of depth, two Q's for the paired organ. A seed made of body parts: V is the rib angle, U the pelvis, X the femurs crossing, A the stance.
Mood
An anatomical plate that answers when you touch it.
Accent
One colour, tide — #1a6b78 in light, #6fc6d1 in dark. It draws the vessels, the pin numbers, the rule under every plate head, the ring arc and the projection line. Lime is still only the add control. The spectrum lights organs and only organs: an organ's colour is its state word, so it is information, not decoration — and it never sits behind text.
Type
A plate legend, so mono carries every label and number: 10 and 11 px tracked mono for pins, layer switches and units; 13 / 15 for names and prose; 21 for the value in an open organ sheet; 34 once per screen, for the number the whole screen is about.
Density
Seven organs, seven pins, seven legend rows, seven day dots. The figure takes 190 px of the 364 px screen and everything else queues under it. Chips are 40 px tall, legend rows 40 px, so the whole row is the tap target. Every gap is --s3 --s5 --s8 --s13 --s21 --s34 and nothing else.
Cards
Plates. No shadow, one hairline at radius 21, one tide rule under the head and a mono plate number inside that head where it can be read. Nothing is stuck on a corner.
Motion
One easing, cubic-bezier(.22, 1, .36, 1), and one duration family: the Fibonacci space scale in milliseconds ×10 — 130, 210, 340, 550 ms. The figure's tilt follows the pointer and settles in 340 ms.
The idea
The body previews itself. The five layers sit at real depth (translateZ 0 / 8 / 21 / 34 / 55 px under a 900 px perspective) so tilting separates skin, bone, blood, organ and pin. And the expectation chart is wired back into the figure: switch plant sterols on and the heart stops being oxblood, because at eight weeks on that plan it will not be oxblood. You watch the projection on your own body.
01

Today, which is a body

Seven systems, drawn where they live. Thyroid and the lipid vessels are oxblood because they are off; blood is amber because ferritin is 22 and HbA1c is 5.6; bones and muscle are grey because grip strength and VO2max were never measured. Tap an organ, or its legend row, and that system's markers open underneath with a ruler, a value and the state word. Move the pointer over the figure: the five layers pull apart. Tap a chip: the check draws, the ring fills, the day dot fills and at five of five the flame catches.

Plan · Doing vs Suggested

PLATE 03B

A suggested row has no habit behind it, so it has no tick box. It gets Adopt instead, and the caption says so before you reach for a box that is not there.

Adopt plant sterols and watch the heart on the figure: the projection is wired into the drawing, so the organ takes the colour it will have in eight weeks.

02

Add, played

The complaint was the four seconds between “Sending” and nothing. Pick an input and press Play: the sheet runs the whole sequence at the speed the app will run it. Text types itself and Send lights. Voice draws a waveform and the transcript lands word by word. One photo gets the scan line, then the callouts one at a time, then the meal card rising with the numbers counting up. Several photos are read in turn, with a tick on each thumbnail as it lands. All four end at the same receipt, and the receipt always offers Undo.

03

The expectation, drawn on the body

The quick view after a meal or a tick: the day's calories against the target, protein, the structure of the day. Then the sentence and the projection. Switch a food rule or a habit and the line redraws, the band widens or tightens, the landing number moves — and the heart on the small figure beside it takes the state it will be in at the horizon. The arithmetic is lib/projection.ts: grade-weighted effect × adherence × horizon, summed, clamped by MAX_CHANGE. Drag across the plot and the tooltip follows your finger.

Drag across the plot. The card carries the date, the value, the unit and whether it is a draw or a projection, and it never claims a state word for a number nobody measured.

The arithmetic, printed

PLATE 09B · RECOMPUTED
Contribution Grade Adh. mg/dL
Total, clamped at 50 mg/dL

A and B count in full, C is halved, D and E never project. The band is the grade-weighted spread: an A contribution is allowed to be 30 % wrong, a B 40 %. The contributions add up because that is how the trials measured them, separately, and nobody has measured the combination.

04

Meals, and a meal

Rows became cards, because a row cannot hold a thumbnail and a thumbnail is how you find the meal you meant. Tap a card to open Edit and Delete — the two verbs that were out of reach. The detail keeps the photograph as its hero, the portion stepper, the ingredients with amounts, Fix results and the confirm that names every write it is about to undo.

06

The same, in dark

The owner runs the phone in dark, so the direction has to hold there. Tide lifts to #6fc6d1 so the vessels keep 3:1 against the dark canvas; the silhouette is drawn from the ink ladder, so it inverts with the theme and never needs a second asset. The spectrum lifts too, so an oxblood thyroid stays an oxblood thyroid. The toggle at the top right flips the whole document.

07

Motion, stated

One easing everywhere: cubic-bezier(.22, 1, .36, 1). One duration family, the Fibonacci space scale ×10: 130, 210, 340, 550 ms. The Swift build copies this table rather than guessing.

What moves Duration Trigger Reduced motion
Figure tilt, rotateX ±5° / rotateY ±9° on five layers 340 ms settle pointer over the figure no tilt, layers flat
Organ fill, state colour to state colour 340 ms a tick, an adopt, a horizon change colour swaps with no transition
Loud organ, opacity 1 → 0.55 → 1 2 600 ms loop the system with the worst marker held at full opacity
Vessel flow, dash offset 0 → −52 3 400 ms loop always, on the blood layer static dashes
Organ sheet, rise 5 px and fade in 340 ms tap an organ or a legend row appears in place
MoveChip fill and scale 0.96 → 1.03 → 1 210 ms tap fill only, no scale
Check draw, stroke-dashoffset 21 → 0 340 ms, 80 ms in the chip turning on drawn already
ProgressRing arc, stroke-dashoffset 340 ms the count changing jumps to the new arc
StreakFlame pop and flicker 340 ms, 3 × 1 300 ms the fifth of five colour only
ReadingLoader dots 550 ms loop the read starting three static dots
ScanOverlay line and shimmer 1 900 ms loop a photo arriving no sweep, one “Looking at the plate” row
Callout rise, 5 px from below 210 ms, 210 ms apart each item detected all four appear at once
MealCard numbers counting up 550 ms, cubic out the card arriving final numbers, no count
Projection line and landing number 210 ms a switch, a horizon pill, an adopt redraw with no fade
SwipeRow face, translateX −118 px 210 ms tap the card actions appear with no slide
08

Where the numbers and the pictures come from

Data. The same file as ios-2.html: 52 markers with a value, 7 off, TPO 320 IU/mL against normal 0–34, vitamin D 19 ng/mL against 40–60, ferritin 22 ng/mL, LDL 118 mg/dL against the 70–100 goal band, the Aug 1 2026 draw, a 6-day streak with 18 as the best run, three meals on Saturday Sep 5 totalling 1 497 kcal and 93 / 93 / 84 g, steps 10 935 against a 90-day mean of 11 062, exercise 43 min against 49, three strength sessions on file for the week. The projection is lib/projection.ts run in the browser on the seeded interventions: effect × grade weight (A and B 1, C 0.5, D and E 0) × adherence × min(1, horizon ÷ the paper's own duration), summed, clamped by MAX_CHANGE.ldl_cholesterol = 50, with the band from GRADE_SPREAD. Adherence is the Plan rows: psyllium 86 %, oats 64 %, olive oil 85 %, the walk 57 %, resistance 33 %, plant sterols 71 % if it were adopted.

What this page adds, and it is only this. An organ has to open on something, so each of the seven systems carries the rest of its own panel: TSH 4.8 and free T3 2.9 beside TPO; ApoB 104, HDL 48 and triglycerides 96 beside LDL; ALT 28, GGT 31 and alkaline phosphatase 121 under Liver; B12 288 and folate 9.1 beside vitamin D; creatinine 0.95, eGFR 98 and uric acid 6.1 under Kidneys; haemoglobin 14.6, HbA1c 5.6, fasting glucose 97 and fasting insulin 8.4 beside ferritin; grip strength and VO2max under Bones and muscle, both never measured, which is why that organ is grey. Those fifteen values are the phase 36 panel figures carried across; every other number on the page is the one already on file. The figure itself is a diagram, not an image: a silhouette, a bone layer, a vessel layer and seven organ shapes drawn as SVG paths in this file.
